disposition: Do not adopt either deeper conditional-workload challenger. Both worsen whole-population PA and delivered contribution squared error, fail to improve the matched public benchmark, and retain elite-entry and absent-star misses. Preserve the current shallow opportunity and hitting candidate. Close this fixed capacity comparison without a parameter sweep or favorable-subgroup hybrid. The row-order reporting repair changed no fits, targets, comparison or existing forecasts.
next_step: Return to the practical plan's hitting-talent and population-coverage milestone. Reconcile the current rate model with the strongest completed compatible talent experiments and the observed debut/established-player cases before specifying one substantive replacement, rather than launching further workload, team-context or feature sweeps. Prioritize actual representation and shrinkage of cross-level performance and pedigree, not whether a new algorithm happens to lower a pooled score. No new college collection; no protected 2026 access or explorer promotion.
